messages:
lina: Quick reminder — code freeze for 1.5.0-rc starts at 23:30 UTC tonight. Please avoid merging anything non-essential. If you absolutely need a late merge, open an exception ticket with a clear rollback plan and smoke-test steps ASAP.

tom: My PR #712 is only a package version bump + changelog entry. Can that still go in during freeze?

lina: Version bumps + changelog-only edits are fine. Tag the changelog line with `rc-1.5.0:` and add the `docs-rc` label. Once CI is green, a maintainer can merge.

mike: Heads-up — I have a small API behavior adjustment (affects client SDKs). Im preparing an exception now.

mike: Exception filed: https://redwood-internal/release-exceptions/412 — summary: client header parsing tweak; risk: medium; rollback: revert commit + redeploy previous artifact; smoke-tests: `make smoke` (expect 200 on /health and zero 5xx); reviewers: @sdk-team @platform.

release-leads-bot: Exception 412 created and queued for review. Notifying @sdk-team and @platform.

ci-bot: CI for PR #712: unit, lint, changelog-format — queued.

sara: FYI Ive been re-running the integration suite after todays merges and saw a flaky auth test. Rerunning now for a focused pass against main.

josh: Note for teams: runtime or infra-affecting changes after cutoff require formal exception + perf/compat numbers. No exceptions without a rollback patch attached.

mike: Added perf numbers and a rollback patch to the exception. Pinged @platform for emergency review.

lina: Were scheduling a monitoring window 23:15-00:00 UTC (canary + first wave). @ops will watch latency/error dashboards and post updates.

ops: Ack — will monitor error rate, p50/p95 latency, and deploy logs. Ill post brief status checks at 23:20, 23:30, and 23:40. :thumbsup:

release-leads-bot: Snapshot created for rc-1.5.0: build-rc-2026-04-02-15 (artifacts: s3://redwood/releases/2026-04-02/rc-15).

ci-bot: PR #712 passed CI. Ready for maintainer merge.

lina: Merged: PR #712 (docs-only). Exception 412 approved by @platform with condition that smoke-tests pass in canary and rollback is staged. @mike coordinate deploy in the 23:30 canary slot.

mike: Deploying to canary now, will report back.

ops: Canary deploy looks clean so far — brief 0.3% error blip at 23:33, auto-recovered. No manual rollback required.

mike: Smoke checks green. No client-visible regressions on canary. Proceeding to wave 1.

lina: Final note: freeze remains in effect until 06:00 UTC. Only emergency fixes with explicit approval from @release-leads during that window. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. :pray:
